meta.title: Kind words from adopters
meta.description: What adopters and supporters say about Happy Paws Cat Rescue.

s1.p: These are some of the lovely comments from our adopters and supporters.
s1.alt: A silver tabby kitten with folded ears lying on a white windowsill beside a plant

s2.quote: “What an AMAZING experience from start to finish we have had adopting our beautiful kittens. Such a professional and knowledgeable service.”
s2.p2: “Every question I have asked has been answered in depth. Whatever time I message / call it’s always answered.”

list.quote: “Throughout this process, we were never rushed or pressured and so now feel confident that we can give these girls a happy long life.”
list.caption: Lucca Addy

list.quote: “After a video assessment of our living space, our adoption was approved and Sophie was ready to come home. She was brought to our house with everything she needed (bed, food etc) and settled in straight away.”
list.caption: Nichola Davey

list.quote: “Katrina Rose was amazing, very pleasant and responsive. Even set up a chat so I can get to know Milo, as I live a bit far.”
list.caption: Petra Kucerova

list.quote: “First time I’ve ever adopted a cat and Happy Paws made it so easy for me! They were extremely helpful and gave me so much advice for looking after my new baby.”
list.caption: Hannah Bunn

list.quote: “Penny was in beautiful condition a very loving cat so could tell she had been well looked after while in foster care and by previous owners.”
list.caption: Susan Scott

list.quote: “An absolutely wonderful team! It’s lovely to see the work they do for the kitties in their area, finding them their forever homes, providing foster care & offering help and advice to those that need it.”
list.caption:
Purrs Cat Rescue
==Fellow rescue==

list.quote: “Katrina works tirelessly to ensure the best for every cat/ kitten that comes into her care.”
list.caption: Maggie Gilchrist

list.quote: “Katrina has offered support and advice on an elderly cat that had been kicked out and left to fend for itself for 2 years. She took it in, got emergency vet treatment, then found the perfect home for her.”
list.caption:
Janice Peart
==Pet Angels Wearside==

list.quote: “Got two lovely little kittens. Communication was amazing from the start and Katrina and Vicki were really helpful.”
list.caption: Corinna Laurie

s4.p: We love hearing how our cats are getting on. Send us a message, and a photo if you have one.
